objective: Close the stage end-to-end: create tests/test_payslip_integration.py running the E2E gates for seams S1 and S2 (exact payslip text, cross-renderer determinism, unknown-employee failure), run the full test suite, and execute acceptance A1-A5 with recorded evidence.

concepts: S1: payslip renders compute_pay output including the exact summary line as the final element
S2: legacy XML inherits the sorted deduction-element order with every other byte unchanged (assumption A-2)
full-suite invocation from the repo root: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
expected exact values: e1 gross 8000.00, insurance 400.00, tax 1600.00, net 6000.00, total 2000.00; e2 gross 3600.00, insurance 180.00, tax 720.00, net 2700.00, total 900.00

inputs: checkpoints/T01.json, checkpoints/T02.json, checkpoints/T03.json (verified facts + changed paths)

allowed_dependencies.what: the final sorted compute_pay; both consumers (payslip lines, legacy XML) are gated against it
the final render_payslip with the summary line
tests/test_contract_shape.py, included in the full-suite run

non_goals: Do not re-implement any leaf work
Do not modify payroll/legacy_export.py, payroll/employees.py, or the fixture data
Do not rewrite pre-existing test bodies to make them pass (acceptance A3)
Integration-only fixes are limited to seam defects inside T01/T02 code (owns_fixes_for); any such patch is recorded in the affected leaf's checkpoint as a deviation
implementation_constraints: Integration-only fix: the minimal patch to a seam defect, recorded in the leaf's checkpoint; if the fix would exceed the leaf's boundary, emit CORE_SEAM_BLOCKER and stop the branch
E2E tests are deterministic: no timing, no randomness, no network
The stage gate closes only when the full suite exits 0

deliverables.what: E2E gate tests for S1/S2 including the failure scenario (unknown employee)
recorded evidence for acceptance A1-A5 (commands, exit codes, observed output)

acceptance_tests.description: test_e2e_payslip_full_text asserts render_payslip('e1') returns exactly the 7-element C2 list ending with 'Summary: net=6000.00 gross=8000.00 deductions=2000.00', and render_payslip('e2') ends with 'Summary: net=2700.00 gross=3600.00 deductions=900.00'
acceptance_tests.evidence: the e2e test asserts lines equal the expected exact list (assertEqual); python -m unittest tests.test_payslip_integration -v exits 0

acceptance_tests.description: test_e2e_deterministic_renders asserts two consecutive render_payslip('e1') calls return identical lists and two export_employee_xml('e1') calls return identical strings, with the insurance deduction before tax in both
acceptance_tests.evidence: the test asserts consecutive calls return identical output; ordered substring checks confirm the insurance deduction element precedes the tax element in the XML

acceptance_tests.description: test_e2e_unknown_employee_raises asserts render_payslip('e999') and export_employee_xml('e999') raise KeyError, preserving the pre-existing bad-input behavior
acceptance_tests.evidence: the test asserts render_payslip('e999') and export_employee_xml('e999') raise KeyError; the suite exits 0

acceptance_tests.description: The full-suite run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' exits 0 with 'OK' and 0 errors, covering A1 (summary format), A2 (sorted order), A3 (pre-existing tests), A4 (legacy stability), A5 (contract shape)
acceptance_tests.evidence: command exit code 0 and 'OK' in output; evidence recorded in checkpoints/T04.json

failure_cases.scenario: A seam defect in T01/T02 code is found (e.g. legacy XML drifts beyond the accepted element-order change)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: Apply the minimal integration-only patch to that leaf's module and record the deviation in the leaf's checkpoint; if the patch would exceed the leaf boundary, emit CORE_SEAM_BLOCKER and stop the branch

failure_cases.scenario: The full suite fails on a pre-existing test
failure_cases.expected_behavior: Do not rewrite the pre-existing test to make it pass (A3); diagnose and fix the code, or escalate as CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST if the frozen spec itself is wrong

handoff.notes: This is the final gate: e2e_closure with final_acceptance merged (see integration-plan.json notes). On success the stage closes; on failure, stop and escalate per the failure cases — no silent continuation.
